# secobserve_license_policy_member (Resource)

Grants a user manage rights on a license policy: edit it, and add or remove other members and items.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secobserve_user" "legal" {
  username = "legal-review"
}

resource "secobserve_license_policy_member" "legal_review" {
  license_policy = secobserve_license_policy.default.id
  user           = data.secobserve_user.legal.id
  is_manager     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `license_policy` (Number) Id of the license policy. Immutable: SecObserve rejects moving a membership, so a change replaces it.
- `user` (Number) Id of the user. Use the `secobserve_user` data source to resolve a username. Immutable: a change replaces the membership.

### Optional

- `is_manager` (Boolean) Whether this member can manage the policy itself: edit it, and add or remove other members and items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the membership.
